title: Championship Week Start/Sit (Week 13)
parts:
🏆 CHAMPIONSHIP WEEK START/SIT | Week 13

Rivalry week is title week in most devy leagues. Same method as every week: season production regressed early, times this week's implied team totals.

Fantrax scoring. Next kick: TCU @ Texas Tech, Thu 8 ET, ESPN.

🧵👇

✅ START

Bear Bachmeier, QB, BYU (SO) vs Cincinnati
28.1 proj. BYU implied 36 vs 30.7 a game. 7.4 AY/A, and 5 rush TD in his last 2.

Rasean Jones, WR, Boise State (FR) @ Colorado State
23.0 proj. Targeted on 28% of Boise's throws, 3.26 yds per team pass att.

✅ START

Dylan Riley, RB, Boise State (JR) @ Colorado State
26.0 proj, RB1. 48% of Boise's carries. CSU allows 45.0 FP/G to RBs, most in FBS.

Trey'Dez Green, TE, LSU (JR) @ Arkansas
16.5 proj, TE1. Targeted on 20% of LSU's throws, 8+ in each of his last 4.

💥 SMASH SPOT

DeAree Rogers, WR, Northern Illinois (SR) vs UTEP, 59% rostered
23.1 proj. NIU implied 27.5 vs 16.5 a game.
Targeted on 30% of NIU's throws, 37.8% of its receiving yards. UTEP allows 32.9 FP/G to WRs.

⛔ SIT (or temper expectations)

Justice Haynes, RB, Georgia Tech @ Georgia (84% rostered)
10.1 proj vs 15.5 FP/G. GT implied 10. Carry share 43% to 28%, last 3.

Umari Hatcher, WR, Syracuse vs Notre Dame (85%)
15.6 proj vs 23.7 FP/G. 40% of Cuse's rec yds; implied 14.

⛔ SIT, continued

Wayne Knight, RB, UCLA vs USC (98%)
14.8 proj vs 20.1 FP/G. 13.4 FP/G his last 3. UCLA implied 19.25 vs 30.9 a game.

Darius Taylor, RB, Minnesota @ Wisconsin (72%)
10.8 proj vs 14.3 FP/G. 3.2 yds/carry. Minnesota implied 15 vs 23.3 a game.

🌙 DEEP SLEEPERS (≤25% rostered)

Leon Haughton Jr., TE, Old Dominion (4%) vs Southern Miss
13.6 proj. ODU implied 28 vs 17.2 a game. 18 targets his last 2 (23% of team throws).

Luke Gilbert, TE, Jax State (SO, 12%) @ Delaware
11.6 proj. 18.8% of JSU's rec yds.

What breaks this card: two of the five starts are Boise State, in a flex game that doesn't count in the Pac-12 standings, six days before the title game vs SDSU. If Boise rests starters, Riley and Jones sink together.

All graded next week. Who are you starting? 👇
